checks.name: Desktop starts with keyboard layout and no touch deck
No gamepad does not erase touch-owned movement or attack
Circle rolls in peaceful areas; only Options opens pause
All six rolls have stable distance and duration independent of frame rate
Roll stops at walls with full body radius at high and low frame rates
Ryuchi roll completes through the real game update without double displacement
Player 2 is smoothly pulled around a building without teleport or wall penetration
Map entry near a wall finds a valid player 2 spawn
Two controllers do not advance player 2 during pause
Player 2 can leave a blocked legacy position without disconnecting
Final bosses expose a recovery window after the pattern resolves
Final boss alternates its aimed attacks between both players
iPhone automatically gets portrait mobile layout with large targets
Real multitouch holds movement and attack; releasing one finger preserves the other
Rotation switches layout and releases all held touches
Mobile can connect and disconnect a physical controller and return to touch
